0022600128.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) visit the Boston Celtics (1-1) for the Nets' fourth game of the 2026-27 season, as they sit 5th in the Atlantic and 14th in the East. Brooklyn is 0-2 at home and 0-1 on the road, and Tyler Bilodeau is out with a shoulder sprain while Mikel Brown Jr. is day-to-day with a rest-related game-time decision, and Boston is without Devin Carter, who is out with an illness. The teams have not met yet this season, and Brooklyn lost 1-3 to Boston in 2025-26, including a 148-111 loss in Boston on February 27, 2026.
